title: No wisdom and no attainment
subtitle: A Heart Sutra passage on knowing and attaining
timeLabel: Heart Sutra Chinese translation and circulation context
shortSummary: The line invites a distinction between the sutra's context of non-attainment and a modern denial of knowledge.
curatorialDescription: The museum keeps the line within the Heart Sutra's structure instead of turning it into a context-free motivational maxim.
researchNote: Version locator, punctuation and commentarial interpretations of wisdom and attainment still need to be added.
